roles.email_body:
Dear Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in the Internship Opportunity with us.

As part of the selection process, please complete the attached case study and submit this within 3 business days.

JD and Assignment has been attached in the drive link provided.

This is a great opportunity for you to showcase your analytical thinking, creativity and problem-solving approach. We encourage you to put forward your best work.

Further details regarding the process will be shared later.

We look forward to reviewing your submission and wish you all the very best!

Thank you,

Regards
HR Team
